scope: Current production candidate consumer design — read-only source inspection plus 77 passing tests

stages.observed: 12 registered signals, causally generated from historical draws, with profiles and quality metrics
quality/utility/context/redundancy produce normalized signal weights, 60 aggregate scores and rank60
historical rank outcomes update calibrator after result; default strength=0.0 neutralizes probability adjustment
60 values attached and SHA-256 re-signed; neutralized mode yields 0.1 per number, probability_sum~6
candidate pool and auxiliary portfolio optimize frozen champion aggregate scores, not neutralized calibrated probabilities
one sorted 6-of-60 card selected from frozen champion scores and recorded with freeze/portfolio/selector proofs, with no target result consumed

limitation: Construction and historical signal influence are not evidence of statistical superiority over uniform lottery selection. The calibration/probability branch is deliberately non-operative in the final-card selector absent out-of-sample evidence.
